summary: Locked, Nix-resolved dependencies for Idris2 and Pack.

values.quickstart:
nix shell 'github:nix-purifiers/idris2-purifier'
idris2-purifier lock
pack build
values.language_tooling_setup: Start the supplied `idris2-lsp` wrapper from the prepared project environment. It uses the selected collection’s compiler and readonly Nix library sources, so definition lookup reaches dependency sources in Nix. Working-tree compilation remains private under `.idris2-purifier/`; ambient `depends/` caches do not select locked dependencies.
